Metadata.Title: Driveclub
Metadata.Name: Red zone fix (particle curve sampler)
Metadata.Note: The function at 0x64d980 keeps seven locals below the stack pointer. A memory-tracking fault taken inside it on Windows overwrites them and the game stopped with a read of address 0 at 0x64db13. It gets a real stack frame instead.
Metadata.Author: Ianespaa

Metadata.Title: Driveclub
Metadata.Name: 60 FPS with deltatime
Metadata.Note: Patch version 2.0 features deltatime. this version will break some things in the game, if that is an issue for you, use the other 60 FPS patch. A frame longer than 33 ms is counted as 33 ms so a slow frame cannot throw the camera.
Metadata.Author: illusion, u/Charlie_Muggins

Metadata.Title: Driveclub
Metadata.Name: 60 FPS with fixed tickrate
Metadata.Note: Enables 60 FPS with the engine's builtin way to do it, making this version work with features that break with the other 60 FPS patch enabled.
Metadata.Author: kalaposfos
